closest_comparator: The preceding complex theorem controls each fixed finite profile space. This theorem proves convergence on the entire localized unit ball in H2 for p and H2 with square-root logarithmic Fourier weight for v, first by a localized logarithm bound and the uniform arbitrary-epsilon thermal comparison, then by positive-measure analytic control. No full exterior inverse follows from this compression.
